title: Another video shows the intensity of the deadly earthquake in Venezuela
text:
Another video shows the intensity of the deadly earthquake in Venezuela"

"🔹One month after two powerful earthquakes, measuring 7.2 and 7.5 in magnitude, struck Venezuela, the full scale of this natural disaster continues to unfold, and the death toll is rising."

"🔹According to official sources, 5,208 people have lost their lives so far as a result of these two earthquakes, and more than 16,000 others have been injured."

"🔹Venezuelan authorities have warned that the death toll is likely to increase further, and the complete human cost of this tragedy may never be known with absolute certainty."

"🔹These two earthquakes, which shook Venezuela and parts of the American continent on June 24, have been followed by more than 1,400 aftershocks.
